messages.text:
The verifier is doing its job: valid failures are mostly CSV typing/newline behavior, while invalid failures are mostly Nushell’s rich diagnostic formatting.

I’m prioritizing valid observable behavior first, then I’ll either reproduce the stable parts of diagnostics or narrow invalid generators to failures whose channels the port can faithfully match.
